text: 利比亚东部议会发言人表示，议会原则上接受央行行长纳吉·伊萨的辞职，并任命央行董事会成员福齐·穆斯巴赫·阿布胡扎姆接任该职务。
text_en: A spokesperson for Libya's eastern parliament said the parliament accepted in principle the resignation of central bank governor Naji Issa and appointed central bank board member Fouzi Musbah Abouzam to succeed him in the post.
